recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If Financial Management wants direct Claim search by Claim.procedure.procedure[x] or item product/service codes, a new or reopened tracker should explicitly define the search parameter names, expressions, and handling of CodeableConcept values versus referenced Procedure.code values.
issue_request: FHIR-22634 asked for Claim search support by procedure code; it is Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution stating that changes similar to the request had already been applied in R4.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-22634. The relevant prior application is R4 Claim work, including FHIR-19484 and the consolidated afb5ec66f6 commit, that added Claim.procedure.udi and Claim search rows for procedure-udi, item-udi, detail-udi, and subdetail-udi. Later source refactors preserved the procedure-udi search parameter in source/claim/bundle-Claim-search-params.xml.
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Claim.procedure.procedure[x] carries a clinical procedure code or Procedure reference, while Claim.procedure.udi is a Device reference and the active search bundle defines procedure-udi over Claim.procedure.udi. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that expands the published Jira resolution into a required new procedure-code token search parameter.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Adding a new Claim procedure-code token search parameter would create a distinct new search surface beyond the final FHIR-22634 disposition.

related_jiras.note: R4 Published issue added UDI to Claim.procedure, underpinning the procedure-udi search parameter cited as similar prior work.
R4 Claim search-description work was included in the same consolidated Claim commit that added the UDI search rows.
Later no-change request about renaming Claim.procedure.udi confirms the UDI element remained intentionally named; it does not require action for FHIR-22634.

evidence_items.learned: This is the final WG disposition and frames reconciliation as confirming the R4-style Claim search support remains present rather than inventing a new search parameter.

evidence_items.summary: The active Claim search parameter bundle defines Claim-procedure-udi with code procedure-udi and expression Claim.procedure.udi.
evidence_items.learned: The R4-style procedure UDI search support cited by the Jira disposition is still present in current source.

evidence_items.summary: Claim.procedure.procedure[x] carries the clinical procedure code/reference, while Claim.procedure.udi is a Device reference.
evidence_items.learned: A direct procedure-code search parameter would be semantically different from preserving the existing R4 UDI search parameter and would need explicit WG direction.
